flags.text: A summons-content statute does not establish a two-document commencement rule for every California consumer debt matter.
The cited form is missing, and no provided source addresses the legal significance of collection communications.
A reader who receives only one document could infer that no suit exists and overlook a summons response deadline.

result.summary: The statute supports the court-name and response-period claims. It does not establish what starts a lawsuit, verify a case-number field, or address collection letters and calls.
